# What is in the IoT kit
The IoT kit has a controller board, a temperature sensor, a light sensor, a motion sensor, an LED, a buzzer, a small display and connecting wires. IoT means Internet of Things: everyday objects that sense the world and send data.

# Connecting the kit
Connect the controller board to your computer with the USB cable. Open the IoT subject in Grovator and press Connect Kit. Choose your kit from the list. When the status light turns green the kit is connected. If it does not connect, unplug the USB cable, plug it in again and retry.

# Plugging in sensors
Each sensor goes to a numbered port on the board. The lesson tells you which port to use, for example light sensor on port 2. Plug the wire in firmly and check the port number in your blocks matches the real port.

# Reading sensor values
Use a sensor block such as "temperature value" inside your program. Put it in a display or say block to show the reading. Warm the sensor with your hand and watch the number go up.

# Sending data
Use the "send data" block to share a sensor reading with the dashboard. Your teacher can see the data in the class view.
